decision: Whether a learned ordering of engine-valid shapes merits a research-only shadow comparison with deterministic ordering
target: Observed next string/fret shape conditional on its pitch-class multiset and previous observed shape; not difficulty, teaching quality, harmonic truth, or learner outcomes

dataset.name: GuitarSet
dataset.input: Existing normalized-recordings.jsonl; preserve upstream errata and stable-note exclusions

extraction.collapse: Consecutive identical accepted shapes, with first occurrence retained
extraction.transition: Consecutive accepted shapes in one recording, no more than 2 seconds apart; previous observed shape is supplied, not predicted
extraction.candidateInput: Exact pitch-class multiset and voice count; never observed target MIDI register or coordinates

candidates.enumeration: All one-note-per-string realizations, matching the full pitch-class multiset; open strings excluded from span; muted strings allowed; no target injection or truncation
candidates.uncovered: Retain test rows with zero reciprocal rank and top-k recovery; omit unavailable choice labels from fitting and conditional log loss

folds: 18 blocks: hold out each of six performers crossed with each of three progression families. Train excludes both the held-out performer and held-out family. Test is their intersection. No tuning on test data.

candidate.objective: Recording-balanced mean conditional negative log likelihood plus 0.01/2 times squared L2 norm
candidate.standardization: Training candidate rows only, zero variance becomes one

baselines: SHA256 stable candidate order independent of target
lexicographic fretted span, fret center, skipped strings, coordinates
lexicographic sorted voice movement, hand center movement, fretted span, coordinates
training-only observed relative-shape frequency, ties compact order

metrics.primary: Recording-macro mean reciprocal rank including uncovered targets as zero
metrics.sensitivity: Paired macro differences across each performer and each progression family; six people/three families do not establish population generalization

gate.actionIfPass: Research-only shadow candidate; no default learner policy deployment

externalConformance.scope: Acquire MIDI chord annotations only; compare independent candidate enumeration with recorded coordinates, note formula and bass; prescribed shapes are coverage fixtures, never preference labels

publication.allowlist: Licensed derived numeric examples, public source record IDs, manifests and attribution, fold metrics, coefficients, prediction evidence, source snapshots
publication.excluded: User scores, user metadata, private practice history, credentials, audio
publication.verification: Server readback, fresh artifact download, byte hashes, and prediction replay

stopRules: Source or frozen implementation hash changes
